name: Lat Pulldown

instructions.description: Sit with thighs secured and grasp the bar comfortably.
Begin with arms overhead and trunk upright.
Pull the bar toward the upper chest while bringing elbows down.
Control the return until the arms are extended.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Lat Pulldown — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Lat Pulldown — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Pull toward the upper chest without forcing the shoulders.
